test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which team on the Pro Kabaddi League title of Season 8 in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is**__ "Dabang Delhi KC"__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dabang Delhi KC** won the Pro Kabaddi League Season 8 Trophy in 2022 over Patna Pirates.
 
• They became the **sixth team **in the league's history to win the title.
 
• **Perfect Raider of the final - **Naveen Kumar
 
• **Defender of the Final -** Manjeet Chhilar

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This was the **eighth season **of the Pro Kabaddi League.
 
• The venue was Sheraton Grand Hotel and Convention Center in Whitefield, **Bangalore.**
 
• The Pro Kabbadi League was launched in** 2014.**
